description: This file defines service functions for managing gym membership plans and user memberships, including creating, listing, updating, deleting plans, subscribing users, and retrieving or canceling current memberships.

methods.name: create_plan
methods.description: Creates a new gym membership plan with specified details.

methods.name: list_plans
methods.description: Returns a list of all existing membership plans.

methods.name: update_plan
methods.description: Updates details of an existing membership plan identified by plan_id.

methods.name: delete_plan
methods.description: Deletes a membership plan identified by plan_id.

methods.name: subscribe_user_to_plan
methods.description: Subscribes a user to a specified plan, activating membership and creating a payment record if in test mode or no Stripe key.

methods.name: cancel_current_membership
methods.description: Cancels the user's current active membership.

methods.name: get_current_membership
methods.description: Retrieves the user's current active or pending membership.
